SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_LIST_SITES.instruction: List/search the SharePoint sites available via Microsoft Graph. Use this first to discover which sites exist (e.g. the proposals/past-performance team sites) before browsing. Pass search='*' for all sites or a keyword to narrow. Each result has a site id you pass to the drive/list tools.

SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_LIST_SITE_DRIVES.instruction: List the document libraries (drives) inside a site. Pass site_id (from LIST_SITES). Use this to find where files live within a site; each drive has a drive_id used by the children/download tools.

SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_GET_DEFAULT_DRIVE.instruction: Get the site's default document library (the 'Shared Documents' drive). Pass site_id. A quick way to get the main drive_id without listing every library.
SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_GET_DEFAULT_DRIVE.usage: Get a site's default library drive

SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_LIST_DRIVE_ROOT_CHILDRE.instruction: List the folders and files at the ROOT of a document library. Pass drive_id. Use to see the top level of a library before drilling into a folder.

SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_LIST_DRIVE_ITEM_CHILDRE.instruction: List the folders and files inside a specific folder. Pass drive_id and item_id (the folder's id). Recurse by passing a child folder's id as item_id. Use to walk deeper into a library's structure.

SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_GET_DRIVE_ITEM.instruction: Get a file/folder's metadata by its id. Pass drive_id and item_id. PREFER this when `search_sharepoint` already gave you the drive_id + item id of the node — it's the most reliable way to resolve a specific item.
SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_GET_DRIVE_ITEM.usage: Get a SharePoint item by id

SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_DOWNLOAD_DRIVE_ITEM.instruction: Download one file's content by its id. Pass drive_id and item_id. PREFER this to open a file that `search_sharepoint` surfaced (it returns drive_id + the item id). Use only for the specific file you need to ground the email/proposal — never bulk-download.
SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_DOWNLOAD_DRIVE_ITEM.usage: Read one SharePoint file's content by id

SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_LIST_LISTS.instruction: List the SharePoint Lists in a site (structured-data tables — trackers, registers, opportunity logs). Pass site_id. Use to discover data lists that may hold relevant info (e.g. an opportunities or past-performance list).

SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_LIST_LIST_COLUMNS.instruction: Get the columns (schema) of a SharePoint List. Pass site_id and list_id. Use to understand what fields a list holds before reading its items.

SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_LIST_LIST_ITEMS.instruction: Read the items (rows) of a SharePoint List. Pass site_id and list_id. Use to pull the specific records you need (e.g. relevant past-performance entries) to ground the email — request a narrow set, not the whole list.
SHAREPOINT_GRAPH_LIST_LIST_ITEMS.usage: Read items from a SharePoint List
